scope: Native publication identity and frontend source ownership. No screenshots, Computer Use, UAC or native pointer/keyboard acceptance.
originalFailure: A bare NodeId can resolve a different file after the loaded SharedIndex is replaced because node IDs are local to each index.
behavior: The same published Arc retains its identity when only its date changes
A different Arc receives a different identity, even if a NodeId is reused
Clearing invalidates the identity, and reinstalling the same removed Arc gets a fresh identity
Indexed IPC carries the originating identity before resolving nodes or duplicate groups
Cancellable query completion checks that its captured Arc remains current
Frontend index adoption clears selection, details and scope and remounts indexed views
Delayed management replies cannot publish after the frontend identity changes
Terminal scan identity and date are captured together before operation release
